Today’s Report

We’re gearing up for another winter here at Castle Mountain Resort! We can’t wait to welcome you back for another season of fresh snow, big turns, and unforgettable mountain moments. Opening day can’t come soon enough!

Castle Mountain Resort is currently closed to all mountain traffic. Please respect the closure and give our team the space they need to prepare for the upcoming season.

Get ready for winter! WOW passes are available now, so be sure to grab yours and lock in 50% off lift tickets, all season long. Visit our WOW Pass page for pricing and details.
